name: Sidestory-1. Tihoe rozhdestvo
source: It's January 6th, there's a monstrous snowstorm outside, and our protagonist, Sasha, would be happy to sit at home in the warmth, but a friend invites him to go camping. Why go camping in such weather? What business does a friend have a hundred kilometers from Moscow? And will the storm subside by Christmas?
